sentences: I measure the illuminance at the desk with a lux meter and record the reading in the logbook.
I check the color temperature of the overhead fixture by comparing it to a 4000 Kelvin reference card.
I replace the fluorescent tube when it starts to flicker at a rate of about two times per second.
I adjust the dimmer slider until the light level matches the previous setting from yesterday.
I note the shadows cast by the lamp on the wall and their approximate length.
I switch on the task light and verify that the beam angle covers the entire work surface.
I record the lumen output of the ceiling panel as listed on the manufacturer's specification sheet.
I check the color rendering index of the LED bulb by looking at the label on the box.
I open the blinds in the morning and note the time when direct sunlight reaches the floor.
I turn on the porch light at dusk and turn it off again at dawn each day.
I test the emergency light by pressing the test button and listening for the alarm.
I wipe the dust off the diffuser panel so the light output remains consistent across the room.
I position the desk lamp so the light falls on the keyboard without causing glare on the screen.
I set the occupancy sensor to turn off the lights after ten minutes of no motion.
I replace the halogen bulb with an LED equivalent and compare the brightness at one meter.
I adjust the white balance on the camera to match the indoor lighting conditions.
I note the beam spread of the recessed spotlight and the distance between each fixture.
I check the voltage on the dimmer circuit to ensure it stays within the specified range.
I record the time of sunrise and sunset in the log to track seasonal changes in daylight.
I turn the lamp's switch to the middle position and note the corresponding light intensity.
